sade_sati_12th.title: Sade Sati — first phase (12th from Moon)
sade_sati_12th.summary: A reflective stretch: closure, rest, and quietly tying up loose ends. Saturn asks for patience and honest review rather than rushing new beginnings.

sade_sati_1st.title: Sade Sati — peak phase (over the Moon)
sade_sati_1st.summary: Saturn crosses your natal Moon’s sign: emotional habits, comfort, and self-image come up for maturity and steadier rhythms. Favor consistency over drama.

sade_sati_2nd.title: Sade Sati — last phase (2nd from Moon)
sade_sati_2nd.summary: Themes around resources, values, and speech often take center stage. Building sustainable habits and clear boundaries supports this consolidation period.

dhaiya_4th.title: Dhaiya — 4th from Moon
dhaiya_4th.summary: Saturn emphasizes home, inner stability, and foundations. Practical upkeep—space, family logistics, emotional grounding—rewards steady effort.

dhaiya_8th.title: Dhaiya — 8th from Moon
dhaiya_8th.summary: A cycle that highlights change, shared resources, and depth. Transparency and patience with transformation serve you better than control.

none.title: Outside Sade Sati and Dhaiya
none.summary: Saturn is not in the classic Sade Sati or Dhaiya positions relative to your natal Moon. You may still feel Saturn transits elsewhere in your chart.
